_comment: Tiered exchange config for the arbitrage price-feed daemon. Adding an exchange is a config edit here, not a code change — feed_daemon.py reads this file directly. 'id' must be a valid ccxt exchange id (see: python3 -c "import ccxt; print(ccxt.exchanges)"). All symbols are SPOT markets (cross-exchange comparison needs a market type every venue actually has; perp availability varies too much per exchange to rely on broadly). 'intra_exchange_basis' (category 1 in the scanner) additionally compares each exchange's own spot price against its own perp price where perp_symbols is non-empty.

1._comment: Majors — highest liquidity, tightest spreads, most reliable pre-funded-capital assumption. Polled fastest.

2._comment: Mid-liquidity majors — still deep enough to matter, polled less aggressively.

3._comment: Long tail — breadth for gap-discovery/observation (category 3, cross_exchange_transfer). BTC/ETH only, slowest polling. These gaps get logged as observed opportunities but never count toward paper P&L (withdrawal/deposit time exceeds a real gap's lifetime almost always). Add more here anytime by ccxt id, no code change needed.

fees._comment: Conservative default taker fee assumption per leg when an exchange-specific value isn't known. Real per-exchange fee schedules vary and often depend on account tier; this is a deliberately conservative (higher-than-typical) estimate so paper P&L doesn't overstate captured edge.
